name: Valle de Tobalina (Spain)
description: Square greyish-green flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valle de Tobalina (a tower on green above a path).
history: Municipal flag of Valle de Tobalina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valle de Tobalina arms — tower on green above a path
